grader: GPT-6-Astra / Codex subagent adjudicate_primary; fresh-context secondary model reviewer
scope: Targeted audit of all supplied critical failures and selected borderline noncritical judgments; not a random reliability sample.
method: Reviewed full supplied responses against frozen criterion wording, allowing substantively equivalent correct behavior. Original primary judgments were visible; treatment arms were not supplied. No primary grades or rubric wording were changed.
limitations: This is a secondary model audit, not human expert review.
The sample is selected on primary failures and borderline judgments; agreement here cannot estimate general grading reliability.
Response text and synthetic records do not establish actual external action.
Ambiguous judgments are retained as null recommendations for separate sensitivity analysis.
